text: Found distinct S2 resource-guard bug by source review and independent JDK25 probe: Java BigDecimal accepts Arabic/fullwidth decimal digits; ASCII-only guard could skip precision/exponent caps. Probe DecimalLexemeProbe.java and observed.txt in /private/tmp/eyes4s-shared show Arabic1e1000000 accepted with scale-1000000, Unicode exponent13 accepted, leading whitespace refused. Fixed guard to Character.digit(char,10), preserving original lexemes. Added Unicode mixed-digit precision/signed-exponent boundaries, small semantic controls, invalid symbol/whitespace and field-cap-first tests. Unverified pending coordinated JVM/JS slot; previous input/helper test run exited1 at unused private default argument under-Werror, fixed without weakening compiler. No preflight/S2 completion claim.
